phases.name: Reintroduction
phases.intent_summary: 3 days/wk. Compression 'on a line' at 80% then 85-90%. No mound.

phases.name: Intent Restoration
phases.intent_summary: 4 days/wk. Flat-ground pulldowns reach 100%. Mound begins at 50ft ('on the bump, move plate in — groove fastball'). Wk4 is the deload dip.

phases.name: Mound Build
phases.intent_summary: Bullpen ladder climbs 15→50 throws; pitch mix after FB command.
